scientific_integrity: Proof is analytic for all dimensions and cardinalities. Companion exact rational tests are illustrative rather than infinite certification. Novelty is confined to the property-beta restricted infimum and its sharp positive-Crawford robust failure.
scientific_limitations: Applies to complex c_0(I) with at least two coordinates and the canonical property-beta family. No claim is made for real scalars, arbitrary Banach spaces, other norming families, or density of Crawford-attaining operators. Equivalence to an unindexed elementary observation cannot be completely excluded.
title: A maximal Crawford localization gap on complex coordinate spaces
